tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro'i las byang tshogs mchod rtsar phreng bzhugs so:

'di legs pa rang gcig gda'o: EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s rigs kyi ḍākki lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: rigs kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro yi: las byang tshogs mchod rim pa bri: 'di la spyi don bcu bzhi ste: dang po bgegs gtor sbyin nas ni: bka' bsgo mtshams gcod rim pa ni: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: hūṃ nyon cig bgegs dang logs 'dren tshogs: lus ngag yid la gnod pa'i bgegs: bar chad 'byung po thams cad kun: 'di ru ma gnas gzhan du dengs: hūṃ nga ni dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal: rdo rje 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku: sku gsum nyid kyang 'joms par byed: nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na: thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par 'gyur: oṃ shrī badzra hya ghri wa ra tsa hrī ya ha ri ni sa rakṣa u tsa ta ya hūṃ phaṭa: de nas mtshams bcad pa ni: hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: badzra sing ha seng ge'i gdong : badzra bya kri stag gdong ma: mthing nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: gti mug dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: steng 'og dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: ka ka mu kha bya rog gdong : dkar gsal mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: zhe sdang dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: shar sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: hu lu mu kha 'ug gdong ma: ljang nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: phrag dog dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: byang sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: shwa na mu kha khyi gdong ma: dmar nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: 'dod chags dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: nub sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku: su ra ke seng phag gdong ma: ser nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro: nga rgyal dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma: lho sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig: ces mtshams bcad: sum bha ni bzlas so:

de nas spyan drang pa ni: hūm̐ chos dbyings gsal mdangs klong dkyil nas: rig 'dzin brgyud pa gshegs su gsol: sku dang zhing khams gzhal yas nas: yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: snang stong thig le'i gzhal yas nas: rta mgrin yab yum gshegs su gsol: rtse mo rnam bkod bde ba'i zhing : sum brgya drug cu'i gzhal yas nas: rdo rje ḍākki yab yum rnams: sum brgya drug cu gshegs su gsol: mgrin pa ro 'dus longs spyod zhing : bcu drug bkod pa'i gzhal yas nas: rin chen ḍākki yab yum rnams: bcu drug ma lus gshegs su gsol: dran pa rnam bkod chos kyi zhing : sum cu rtsa gnyis gzhal yas nas: sangs rgyas ḍākki yab yum rnams: sum cu rtsa gnyis gshegs su gsol: skyed byed drug cu sprul pa'i zhing : drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gzhal yas nas: padma ḍākki yab yum rnams: drug cu rtsa bzhi gshegs su gsol: myong byed rnam bkod bde ba'i zhing : nyi shu rtsa brgyad gzhal yas nas: las kyi ḍākki yab yum ni: nyi shu rtsa brgyad gshegs su gsol: rtsa khams rang bzhin gnas pa'i zhing : bkod pa lus kyi gzhal yas nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bye ba stong : ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: de dag kun gyi bka' 'khor na: phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu chen brgyad: stong gsum 'jig rten khams dag na: gnas bzhugs rigs bsdus ma sring tshogs: 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki ni ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya sa ma ya bi shwa lo ka ḍākki ni sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: phaiṃ phaiṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā: zhes spyan drang ngo : de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrī gnas lnga ye shes lhun grub dkyil 'khor du: thabs shes nyi zla padma'i gdan stengs su: bla ma bde gshegs ḍākki'i tshogs rnams bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣtha lhan: de nas phyag btsal ba ni: hūm̐ dus gsum bla ma yi dam ḍākki ma: chos nyid rnam dag gtso 'khor bcas pa la:

lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: zhes phyag bya'o: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dang po phyi yi mchod pa la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: bla ma bde gshegs ḍākki la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mdzes pa'i me tog spyan la 'bul: dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul: snang gsal mar me spyan la 'bul: yid 'ong chab bsil thugs khar 'bul: zhal zas ro mchog ljags la 'bul: rol mo sna tshogs snyan la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don du mchod do bzhes: de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: bla ma bde gshegs ḍākki la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog mchod: bsur chen dri yi bdug spos mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar me mchod: rdo rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod: bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchod: rkang gling thod rnga dril bus mchod: byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsis mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang las: 'khril sbyor byang chub sems kyis mchod: bde ba'i ro snyoms mchod par bzhes: sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥ bla ma bde gshegs ḍākki la: ye shes mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bde gsal rig pa mi rtog snang : snang ba sna tshogs thams cad kun: bde stong gsal stong rig pa stong : mi rtog snang ba rang bzhin stong : ye shes lnga ldan ngang du bzhes: de nas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: bla ma bde gshegs ḍākki la: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: dug lnga gnas bsgyur ye shes bsgrub pa'i rdzas: ro mchog yon tan kun dang ldan pa 'di:

gsol lo mchod do 'gro ba'i don la bzhes: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: de nas gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūṃ: bla ma bde gshegs ḍākki la: gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: zhal zas sna tshogs gtor chen la: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rgyan ldan: dri mchog ro brgya ldan pa yi: bha liṃ rgyan can gtor ma 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi tshogs mchod 'di la bcur gnas pa las: dang po phrin gdags pa ni: ho gsan cing dgongs su gsol: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong dkyil nas: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rta mgrin yab yum mkha' 'gro 'bu tsho yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus gsan cing dgongs su gsol: ces bya'o: de nas gnyis pa tshogs kyi dri ma sbyang ba ni: tshogs la bsang chu gtor la: swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod: hūm̐ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos rnams sgyu mar rig bya'i phyir: dngos dang dngos 'dzin bag chags kun: yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis: bsreg cing bkrus te gtor bar bya: dag par ma gyur gang yang med: raṃ khaṃ yaṃ: swā hā: zhes brjod pas dag par bsam mo: oṃ āḥhūṃ hrī:trāṃ: ye shes rnam lnga'i rang bzhin las: zhal zas dngos po yi ge lnga: yi ge sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu: 'od phung 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis: rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ces byin gyis brlab bo: gsum pa yul spyan drang ba ni: las byang gi spyan 'dren la: longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ces btags: dbyangs rta snyan pos spyan drangs so: bzhi pa mchod cing bstab pa ni: hūṃ dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: rta mgrin yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab:

tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: mkha' 'gro sde lnga yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: de sogs ḍākki'i rigs gyur ma lus kun: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dam tshig sha za 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad kyang : dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: 'jig rten snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyang : dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūṃ hrī:ma hā ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya ma hā kā la ma ma rag mo ru tri ya ma ra tsa ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa khā hi: ma hā tsitta khā hi: ma hā rakta khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi: ma hā ba su ta khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: zhes lan bdun gyis 'bul lo: lnga pa tshogs kyis bskang ba ni: hūṃ bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskang : tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : dus gsum bla ma yi dam yang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'dzin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rakta dza gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dpal chen khro rgyal rta mgrin yab yum yang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'dzin gyi thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rakta dza gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dang bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ḍākki sde lnga yab yum 'khor bcas kyang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'dzin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rakta dza gad thugs dam bskang :

glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dang bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: snang srid mkha' 'gro ma lus thams cad kyang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'dzin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rakta dza gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: chos skyong srung ma ma lus 'khor bcas kyang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'dzin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rakta dza gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: snang srid lha 'dre ma lus 'khor bcas kyang : zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang : lta spyod ting nge 'dzin gyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi rakta dza gad thugs dam bskang : glu gar sgrub pa dam tshig thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ces bskang ngo : drug pa tshogs kyi bshags pa bya ba ni: gong gi bshags pa la: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pa: zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas so sor bshags: zhes btags la bshags pa bya'o: bdun pa liṅga bsgral ba ni: tshogs phud tha ma la dgra bgegs kyi ling ga bcas la lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas: a mu ka nṛ aṃ gu sha dza: zhes pas yul gang yin gyi rnam par shes pa bkug la: badzra pā sha hūṃ: zhes zhags pa'i phyag rgyas bcings: badzra spho ṭa baṃ: zhes pa lcags sgrog gi phyag rgyas bsdams: badzra ghanḍe ho: zhes dril bu'i phyag rgyas gzugs dang rnam shes dbyer med du bsre'o: de nas ngag tu: hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod pas bdag rta mgrin yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa stod gzhung dang mthun pa: smad phur pa lcags sol mal nas bton pa lta bur bsam la 'di skad do:

hūm̐ nga ni rta mgrin yab yum ste: 'khor du mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: kun kyang mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs: dmar nag me yi mtshon cha 'phro: khro bo'i gzugs kyis nam mkha' gang : stod ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gnam lcags ngar ma'i phur pa 'dril: smad ni ye shes phur pa ste: nam mkha'i mthongs nas 'dril zhing 'debs: drag por bsgyur ba'i phur pa ste: btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur: gnod byed dgra bgegs smos ci dgos: gzir ba tsam gyis rdul du rlog: hūm̐ nga ni dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal: khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas rnams: phyag gnyis gnam lcags phur pa 'dril: rgya mdud rtse nas 'brug stong ldir: chang bzung mtshams nas glog stong 'khyugs: chu srin kha nas tsha tsha 'phro: rtse mo mtshon cha 'od zer 'gyed: dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: a mu ka u tsa ta ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas blang ngo : de nas brgyad pa bsgral ba dngos la drug las: dang po lha dang dbye ba ni: bhyo rna nyan chen po phra ma mkhan: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: 'go ba'i lha dang bral bar gyis: chgai trag rū tra mā ra ya phaṭa: gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa ni: bhyo las mkhan chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: rnam shes srog la rnam par phob: a mu ka a be sha ya hūṃ phaṭa: gsum pa byad du gzhug pa ni: bhyo 'ching byed chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: zung zhig sdoms shig rnam par chings: a mu ka shri kri a na ya hūṃ phaṭa: bzhi pa smyo ru gzhug pa ni: bhyo smyo byed chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: lus ngag yid gsum smyos par gyis: a mu ka dza la sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa:

lnga pa gtun du brdung pa ni: bhyo rdung byed chen mo'i dus la bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rdungs: a mu ka bhi na ngha ya hūṃ phaṭa: drug pa zhal phye ba ni: bhyo gdug pa sgrol mkhas ḍākki yum gyi tshogs: dgra bgegs sha ni zan bas zhim: dgra bgegs khrag ni chang bas zhim: dgra bgegs rus pa mar bas bzhun: dug gsum mchod pa 'bul ba'i phyir: ma lus 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig: de nas bdun pa zhal du bstab pa ni: bhyo dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus gsum mchod pa 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin yab yum zhal du bstab: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi yab yum zhal du bstab: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro las mkhan zhal du bstab: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: chos skyong srung ma sde brgyad zhal du bstab: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub zhu: rkyen dang bar chad bzlog tu gsol: ma hā rū tra u tsa ta khā hi: ma hā maṃ sa khā hi: rakta khā hi: tsitta khā hi: go ro tsa na khā hi: kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: ba su ta khā hi: ma hā pañtsa khā hi: a mṛ ta khā hi: bha liṃ ta khā hi: zhes lan bdun gyis 'bul lo: bcu pa tshogs la rol cing lhag ma'i cho ga bya'o: bstod pa bya ba ni mngon rtogs bzhin no: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūṃ dus gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dbang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol: ye shes mkha' 'gro yab yum chos kyi sku: ye nas bdag dang dbye ba med pa la: ma rig dbang gis snang stong gnyis su 'thas: gnyis 'dzin the tshom log lta ci bgyis pa: rang mdangs rig pa'i klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūṃ rdo rje ḍākki yab yum gtso 'khor bcas:

sum brgya drug cu gsan cing dgongs su gsol: lta ba ma rtogs log dang rtogs rdzus btab: kha lta bdud dbang song dang log par bltas: yid dpyod mtha' bral klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūṃ rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: yab yum bcu drug gsan cing dgongs su gsol: mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin don las g.yel gyur te: ma gsal ma rig bskyed rdzogs don ma bsgoms: gsal stong bde chen ngang du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūṃ padma ḍākki yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: drug cu rtsa bzhi gsan cing dgongs su gsol: dus la ma bab spyod pa chos dang 'gal: ma rig dbang gi brtsog par ci spyad pa: dmigs med shar grol klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūṃ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: sum cu rtsa gnyis gsan cing dgongs su gsol: yang dag don gyi gnas lugs ma shes te: the tshom dbang gis 'bras bu'i don dang 'gal: re dogs mtha' bral klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūṃ las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum gtso 'khor bcas: nyi shu rtsa brgyad gsan cing dgongs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i srung sdom don ma shes: bya ba kun nas log pa ci bgyis pa: kun mkhyen gsal ba'i klong du mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūṃ kai rī ma brgyad seng ha phra men brgyad: sgo ma bzhi dang dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: lang ka brgyad dang ma bdun sring mo bzhi: ging chen bco brgyad pho nya drug cu bzhi: bstan ma lo ka las la grub pa sogs: kun gyi thugs dang 'gal gyur ci mchisapa: phyi nang gsang ba bdud rtsi gtor tshogs dang : lta sgom spyod pa ting 'dzin thugs dam bskang : thugs dam gnyan skong nyams bshags dngos grub zhu:

bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub tu gsol: ces yi ge brgya pa bzlas so: de nas phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma la phrin las bskul ba ni: bhyo chos dbyings 'gyur med bde chen klong : sna tshogs sprul pa 'gro ba'i zhing : stong gsal longs spyod ḍākki ma: lcang lo dung khang gzhal yas na: sum brgya drug cu'i dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung dkar gsal dbus: thabs shes padma nyi zla la: rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum ni: gtso 'khor sum brgya drug cu ste: sku mdog dkar gsal me long sku: zhe sdang 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs: spyan gsum sdang mig dgra la lta: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mdzod: sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung du gsol: hūṃ mgrin pa longs spyod gzhal yas na: bcu drug bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung ge sar dbus: thabs shes padma nyi zla la: rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum ni: gtso 'khor brgyad gnyis bcu drug ste: sku mdog ser gsal mnyam nyid sku: nga rgyal 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs: spyan gsum sdang mig dgra la lta: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mdzod: sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung du gsol: bhyo dran pa rnam bkod gzhal yas na: sum cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung mthing gsal dbus: thabs shes padma nyi zla la: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum ni: gtso 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis te: sku mdog mthing gsal chos dbyings sku: gti mug 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs: spyan gsum dgra la sdang mig lta:

zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mdzod: sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung du gsol: bhyo skyed byed sprul pa'i gzhal yas na: drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung dmar gsal dbus: thabs shes padma nyi zla la: padma ḍākki yab yum ni: gtso 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi ste: sku mdog dmar gsal sor rtogs sku: 'dod chags 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs: spyan gsum dgra la sdang mig lta: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mdzod: sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung du gsol: bhyo myong byed bde chen gzhal yas na: nyi shu rtsa brgyad dkyil 'khor ni: 'dab bzhi chos 'byung ljang gsal dbus: thabs shes padma nyi zla la: las kyi ḍākki yab yum ni: gtso 'khor nyi shu rtsa brgyad de: sku mdog ljang gsal bya grub sku: phrag dog 'joms phyir thod khrag dkrugs: spyan gsum dgra la sdang mig lta: zhal nas drag sngags bgegs la 'bod: shangs nas nad kyi 'tshub ma 'thor: tshogs gtor mchod pa 'di gsol la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: drag po'i phrin las myur du mdzod: sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung du gsol: de ni nang rig pa'i lha lnga brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis phrin las la bskul ba yin no: da ni yab yum sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro 'bum tsho nyi shu bskul ba ni: bhyo dur khrod rab 'jigs nags ma'i gling : rtsub 'gyur lcang lo can gyi gnas: rus dang rnag khrag mtshon cha'i tshal: sha zan bya spyang mang po'i gnas: khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing :

phyag na rdo rje skyi g.ya'i gnas: de lta bu yi gnas mchog na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum: rdo rje phag mo yab yum bzhugs: yab yum 'khril ba'i spyi gtsug na: phag zhal rta gdong ljang nag las: dgra la khrag nad gtong ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yab yum khro zhal gnyis med sbyor ba las: bde gshegs las la bskul ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yab yum dbu la thod lngas brgyan pa las: rigs lngas 'gro don mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo: yab yum dbu yi thor gtsug 'khyil ba las: bde gshegs dgongs pa bskul ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yab yum phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams pa las: srog gcod bdud len byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: g.yon gnyis bhan dha khrag can bsnams pa las: khrag nad gzer thabs gtong ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo: kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum mchan khung bcug pa las: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: de la rdo rje rtse lngas brgyan pa las: don dam stong nyid rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: thod pa sum brtsegs rab tu brgyan pa las: srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo: dar gyi 'phur lce rab tu mdzes pa las: bdud kyi dmag dpung 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: gser gyi dril bu rnga dung 'phyang ba las: snyan brgyud gdams pa 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yu ba dkar po drang zhing 'dril ba las: lha min g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo: mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba las:

'du byed lnga bcu zad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba las: phar phyin 'gro don mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yab yum gnyis med 'khril bar sbyor ba las: rtog med bde chen rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo: gcer bu skra grol 'gying zhing brjid pa las: stong nyid ye shes rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum rtse gcig bzhugs pa las: pha rol sa bcu gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo: ro yi gdan la rab tu bzhugs pa las: dur khrod sha la rol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa las: thabs shes mthar phyin mun sel mkha' 'gro 'bum: sku yi rgyan rnams rab tu rdzogs pa las: che btsan 'gran zla bral ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: bskal ba'i me ri rab tu 'khrugs pa las: ma rig rtog mtha' sreg pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: 'khor du ḍākki mang pos bskor ba las: sna tshogs phrin las mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ces sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum tsho nyi shu bskul ba'o: 'di gnyan pas tshogs dang gtor ma'i dus min par bya mi nyan no: de nas sna tshogs kyi ḍākki bskul ba ni: bhyo mkha' dbyings bde ba chen po nas: ye shes ḍākki bye ba 'bum: rdo rje mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma: rin chen mkha' 'gro sa ma ti: padma mkha' 'gro bde chen ma: las kyi mkha' 'gro phrin las bdag: kun kyang cha lugs 'di 'dra ste: sku mdog gcig tu ma nges te: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing mun mdog: sngo skya khra mo bral ba'i mdog:

phyag mtshan gcig tu ma nges te: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ thod pa 'dzin: rnga chung rtog 'joms mtshon cha thogs: rol mo'i sgra dang rgyan cha thogs: bdud rtsi mchod pa rol zhing stob: dur khrod rgyan la mdzes pa'i gzugs: sked pa dril bu g.yer khas brgyan: dar dpyangs rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: snyan pa'i sgra sgrog si li li: dbu rgyan dar gyi cod pan can: rlung gis bskyod cing pu ru ru: rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can: mkha' la thogs med bun nu nu: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar byed khyugs se khyug: phrin las gcig tu ma nges te: rnam bzhi sna tshogs nyid mdzad ma: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'dod pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs: de nas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing skyes ma bskul ba ni: hūm̐ gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi na: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo nyi shu bzhi: mkha' 'gro bye ba 'khor dang bcas: gtso mo mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: kun kyang mi bzad 'di 'dra ste: la la bud med rgan mo la: ro shun rnying pa'i na bza' gsol: snum dang khrag gi thig les brgyan: zhal nas ha hi hūm̐ phaṭa sgrogs: rkang pa 'khor lo bzhi yi 'gros: lag pa ber ka sa la gtsugs: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rkyen bzlog dgra thul dngos grus stsol: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: la la bud med gzhon nu la: bcu drug gzugs mdzes lang tsho rgyas: sna tshogs rgyan ldan yid 'ong ma: rigs spyod kha dog so so la: khro gnyer mdzes 'dzum ldan pa'i gzugs: phrin las rnams la bskul ma 'debs: kun kyang cha lugs 'di 'dra ste: mdzes pa'i zhal 'dzum gzi mdangs can: gzhon nu'i sku la 'gying bag ldan: dbu la rin chen cod pan 'phur: rang gi dpa' bo'i zhabs la 'dud: sked pa g.yer kha'i dra ba can: sil sil sgra sgrog sku la sbyor: lag pa mnyen lcugs gdu bu can: rang gi dpa' bo'i mgul nas 'khyud:

sor mo gser gyi sor gdub can: brda dang brda yi lan la mkhas: zhal ni padma'i dung so can: 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis snyan par smra: skad snyan tshangs pa rdo rje'i gsung : snyan pa'i glu len yid 'phrog ma: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rkyen bzlog dgra thul dngos grub stsol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: la la bud med tha mal gzugs: lo ka'i spyod pa sna tshogs byed: khyed ni mi spyod gang yang med: la la sgyur byed tshos mkhan mo: log par lta ba'i rnam rtog sgyur: la la myos byed chang 'tshong ma: log lta'i shes pa myos par gyis: la la sbyor byed smad 'tshong ma: thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba gyis: la la dag byed khrus mkhan mo: bag chags dri ma dag par gyis: la la gsod byed shan pa mo: rtog pa skye med dbyings su sod: la la dka' thub bram ze mo: 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral bar gyis: la la len byed chom rkun mo: gzhan sems rang dbang med par gyis: de la sogs te mtha' yas pa: ri rab lho yi 'dzam gling na: yul gru nyi shu rtsa bzhi na: sems can don la bzhugs pa rnams: mos pa du ma'i sems can la: spyod pa sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul: rakta'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: mi mthun phyogs kyi nyes pa bzlog: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bskul lo: de nas lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di skad do: bhyo: las kyi mkha' 'gro mi srun ma: shin tu 'jigs pa'i keng rus gzugs: yan lag rus pa'i 'khor los brgyan: snying khrag 'thung zhing skan sgra rdeb: rkang mgyogs brtul zhugs gdugs rtsub can: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan mo: dam nyams rū tra'i srog gcod yin: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di long la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: drag po'i las mdzod bstan pa srungs: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

bhyo 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can: srin mo'i lus la lce spyang gdong : sbrul nag lce la spyan mig ldog: kha rlangs dug la nga ro 'brug: khros pas sme khrag ser chen 'bebs: mi lpags g.yang gzhi phyogs bcur rdeb: rgyu zhags 'dom dgu dgra la chings: ba spu mtshon cha me ltar 'bar: byi ba dung phyur 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan mo: dam nyams rū tra'i srog gcod ma: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di long la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: drag po'i las mdzod bstan pa srungs: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bhyo sha za mkha' 'gro yang sprul tshogs: yi dwags lus la dur bya'i gdong : dur khrod sked la thod pas brgyan: lus las khrag rul chu ser 'bebs: smre sngags tshig la ngud mo'i dbyangs: phyi na 'dre 'tshub sprin ltar lding : ro langs rkang la dur khrod lus: phung 'dre'i lag pa gza' srin mig: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan mo: dam nyams rū tra'i srog gcod yin: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di long la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: drag po'i las mdzad bstan pa srungs: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bhyo gzhan yang mkha' 'gro pho nya'i tshogs: la la myur mgyogs bstan pa srung : bu chung lus la bya rog mgo: dbyug gu'i dbyangs la thi bya'i tshig: ri gsum 'grim zhing lung gsum bskor: chu la zhon nas grib so 'grim: lce spyang pho nya dri ro snom: da la'i tha ma bskor zhing nyul: las byed mi sdug 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin: dam nyams rū tra'i srog gcod ma: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di long la: dgra bgegs zhing bcu bsgral du gsol: drag po'i las mdzod bstan pa srungs: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces lhag gtor btang ngo : de nas zor lam dbye ba gzhan dang mthun no:

zor 'phen pa ni: bhyo nga ni rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag: dgra bgegs steng du zor cig 'phen: dgra bgegs gdug pa zor kha long : dreg pa rta mgrin yab yum ste: mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung sde brgyad tshogs: kun kyang drag po'i zor thogs la: dgra bgegs steng du zor kha ya: zor mā ra ya zor yā: zhes 'phang ngo : de nas gtor ma bskyang ba ni: bhyo dpal chen yab yum bka' nyan ma: shar nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad: rdo rje rigs kyi ḍākki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: de bzhin du: lho nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad: rin chen rigs kyi ḍākki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis rgyal pa'i phrin las mdzod: nub nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad: padma rigs kyi ḍākki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis dbang gi phrin las mdzod: byang nas gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad: las kyi rigs kyi ḍākki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis drag po'i phrin las mdzod: dpal chen yab yum bka' sdod bka' nyan tshogs: dbang phyug nyer brgyad ḍākki sum cu gnyis: ging chen bco brgyad lang ka dur khrod bdag: ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma lnga bcu brgyad: drug cu bzhi dang 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror bcas: bshes gnyen klong rdzogs padma'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas bka' yi gtor ma long : zhi rgyas dbang drag dgug bskrad mnan gzir sogs: bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: ces bstan ma skyong ngo : de nas rta bro brdung ba ni: gtor gzhong 'og tu liṅga bcug la:

bhyo dmar nag gru gsum me yi dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs byed khro rgyal rta mgrin khros pa'i sku: gnyis med 'khril sbyor rdo rje phag mo yum: thod sbrul rgyan ldan g.yas gnyis gri gug bsnams: g.yon gnyis thod khrag tri shul rus pas brgyan: rta mgo phag zhal dur mtsher phyogs bcur sgrogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dam la 'dus: sdug bsngal nad kyi tshom bu la: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem: rta bro 'khor gcig dang po la: bdud 'dul 'joms pa chen po'i bro: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: zhing bcu'i tshogs la da rdungs shig: rta bro 'khor gcig bar ma la: srin po sha za longs spyod bro: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'byung po'i tshogs la da rdungs shig: rta bro 'khor gcig tha ma la: khams gsum khrag 'thung nad kyi bro: gti mug 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'khor ba'i gcong nad skran la rdungs: rdul du rlog cig dgra dang bgegs: rgya mtsho'i gting spa ri rab mnan: 'khor bskyon chu srin kha ru bor: oṃ āḥhūṃ stam bha ya nan: ces rta bro brdung ngo : de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūṃ: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje mngon du gyur: chos dbyings rnam dag klong la mnga' brnyes pa'i: bla ma yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: dkar mo zhi mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: me long ye shes rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i lus la dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro 'bum: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ser mo rgyas mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i yon tan dbang sgyur gter gyi ḍākki 'bum: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: dmar mo dbang mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: sor rtogs ye shes padma mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i ngag la dbang sgyur gsung gi mkha' 'gro 'bum:

bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: mthing kha chos mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: chos dbyings ye shes sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i yid la dbang sgyur thugs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ljang gu las mdzad gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: nan tan ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: 'gro ba'i las la dbang sgyur phrin las mkha' 'gro 'bum: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dur khrod brgyad kyi bdag: tshogs brgyad dbang sgyur 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma: bka' srung mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ces bkra shis brjod: lha gshegs

: bsngo ba smon lam bya: dbang gi dus yin na sbyin sreg bya: dal bsdu: yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang : bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang : ma sring las la bskul ba yi: las byang tshogs mchod rtsar phreng 'di: ye shes mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad: las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rdzogs so: athi+-i dge'o: mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (5)mkha' 'gro'i las byang tshogs mchod rtsar phreng*/ - PAGE 168 -- PAGE 169 -- PAGE 147 -
